summary: Holds a scene's entities, their components and its systems. Create entities, attach plain-data components, and run parallel queries over everything that matches. Structural mutation belongs to the creation thread. Queries may be called from a background coordinator and serialize with structural mutation; callbacks may edit their supplied component references or schedule deletion.
summaryText: Holds a scene's entities, their components and its systems. Create entities, attach plain-data components, and run parallel queries over everything that matches. Structural mutation belongs to the creation thread. Queries may be called from a background coordinator and serialize with structural mutation; callbacks may edit their supplied component references or schedule deletion.
